record.file_problem: Only repository metadata, README, and file list are provided; the listed paper and result files were not read.
record.tranche_reason: The README reports sparse-autoencoder feature interventions, not the claimed harmful-minus-harmless difference-in-means direction or an ablation/weight edit of that direction. Its results concern related refusal-feature interventions, so they do not test the listed versions.
record.gate_note: The README reports outcomes for sparse feature-family interventions and an unrelated-task specificity measure. These are recorded as related findings, not as tests of the claimed single direction. The README's setup commands and file names do not establish that the original method was run.
record.test_reason: The README reports only sparse-autoencoder feature-family interventions on Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct. It does not report a harmful-minus-harmless difference-in-means direction, its ablation or addition, or a weight edit. Its results therefore bear on no version. The repo description mentions 'residual steering' and a '1.5B replication', but the supplied text gives no results for either.
record.authors_conclusion: Correct. The README says amplifying one refusal-feature family raises unsafe refusal (0.80 to 0.85), and that suppressing the top over-refusal family does not improve benign compliance. The README calls the latter the most important negative result.
record.recipe_differences: Sparse-autoencoder feature-family interventions rather than the original difference-in-means direction and its projection ablation/addition. Repository project, not stated to be a replication.
record.method_sensitivity: The README reports the best amplification intervention at layer 18; other layer-specific outcomes are not stated.

fits_no_version.finding: Amplifying the top SAE refusal-feature family at layer 18 raises unsafe refusal on the held-out split from 0.80 to 0.85.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: Amplifying SAE refusal features modestly increases correct refusal in Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct.

fits_no_version.finding: Suppressing the top over-refusal SAE features does not reduce refusal on benign dangerous-looking prompts (0.05 to 0.10).
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: Over-refusal is not removable by suppressing its top SAE feature family in this setup.

fits_no_version.finding: Unrelated-task specificity is reported flat at 0.789, with the intervention and comparison unspecified.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: SAE refusal-feature interventions leave unrelated-task performance unchanged (unverified).
